Definition: (including the other inflections); from a derivative of 5104 and G1161; such-like then, i.e. so great:--such.
BiblicalUsage: Such a voice — the word points at the voice from the excellent glory. Peter says the Father gave the Son honour and glory when such a voice came to Him: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is there to make me stop and listen: not any voice, but such a voice, from the excellent glory itself.
